stem_text: A particle moves in one dimension from rest under the influence of a force that varies with the distance travelled by the particle as shown in the figure. The kinetic energy of the particle after it has travelled 3m is : [FIG-stem-1]
figure_reference: [FIG-stem-1] F(x) vs x graph unverified against authentic master

candidate_solve.derivation: By Work-Energy Theorem: KE(at 3m) - KE(initial) = W = integral_0^3 F(x) dx. Since particle starts from rest, KE = integral_0^3 F(x) dx. Area under F(x) curve from x=0 to x=3m cannot be computed without the exact numerical grid and vertices in the diagram.
candidate_solve.limiting_cases: Cannot perform independent integration without original figure.
